lines.en: I cross the cracked red earth.

lines.zh: 这么大的个子，走路很响。
lines.en: A body this size walks loudly.
I move among the dry grasses.
The hot wind works through my fur.
I have never seen snow.

lines.zh: 枯草在我脚边断成一节节。
lines.en: The dry grass snaps into pieces under my feet.

lines.zh: 我在这片荒原上找阴凉。
lines.en: I look for shade on this waste.

lines.zh: 草原的日头，把我的毛晒干。
lines.en: Savanna sun dries my coat.
Dust rolls up behind my feet.
I step on slabs of sun-cracked earth.
There is sand all through my fur.
No need to walk fast.
I crouch under a dead tree.
This shade is too small.
I rake the soil with my claws.
Even the wind is hot here.
My fur keeps the heat in.
I look up. No clouds.
I wait for the sun to move west.
I am covered in yellow dust.
I stay still and save strength.
There are vultures in the distance.
Few living things here.
I draw my claws in.

lines.zh: 草原的干热，把毛吹得打结。
lines.en: Savanna heat knots my fur.
The ground is hot as an oven floor.
I hear the dry grass rustle.
Snow would not be welcome here.
I shake the sand out of my coat.

lines.zh: 我在枯树底下抠出个坑。
lines.en: I dig a hollow under the dead tree.
Are you from the snow too?
There is no snow here.

lines.zh: 草原上的雪怪，个头不矮。
lines.en: A savanna yeti isn't short.
You do not smell of dust.

lines.zh: 草原上这只雪怪，晒得发蔫。
lines.en: This yeti on the savanna is wilting in the heat.
You will die of the heat.
I know this waste.

lines.zh: 你的皮晒得没我这么黑。
lines.en: Your skin is not sun-blackened like mine.

lines.zh: 草原的太阳把你也晒蔫了。
lines.en: The savanna sun has wilted you too.
Do you want water?
I am running dry too.

lines.zh: 你站远点，我身上全是沙。
lines.en: Stand back. I am covered in sand.

lines.zh: 干燥的风吹不动我的毛。
lines.en: The dry wind won't stir my coat.

lines.zh: 干裂的皮又开了一道口。
lines.en: Another split opens in my cracked hide.

lines.zh: 草原的太阳，晒得我这身白毛发亮。
lines.en: Savanna sun bleaches my white fur.
Dust gets into the wound.
I block with a claw.

lines.zh: 伤口上立刻糊了一层土。
lines.en: Dust cakes over the wound at once.
I lean and steady myself.
Blood drips onto hot earth.
I pant.
Still standing.
Everything growing in this dry land is tough.
There is not much to eat here.
Raise it higher. I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 腰弯不下去，只能低头看。
lines.en: My back won't bend; I can only look down.
Set it on the rock.
It smells edible.

lines.zh: 我嚼着干草，嘴里全是沙。
lines.en: I chew the dry grass with a mouthful of sand.
That is one mouthful.

lines.zh: 你手里的草看着还没干透。
lines.en: The grass in your hand does not look dried out.

lines.zh: 你留着吧，我再去别处找。
lines.en: Keep it. I will look elsewhere.

lines.zh: 草原雪怪的腿，撞上去很硬。
lines.en: A savanna yeti's leg is hard to bump.
My bristly coat numbs your hand.
My fur is thick.
Sand got in your eyes.
I shift aside a little.
There is no wall here to lean on.
I turn and dust billows up.

lines.zh: 草原上的雪怪，晒得皮发干。
lines.en: A yeti on the savanna, my hide drying in the sun.
A bump will not hurt you.
Call out before you come close.

lines.zh: 这么大的个子，也得有个伴。
lines.en: Even a body this size needs company.

lines.zh: 草原上的雪怪，一百六十点血。
lines.en: A savanna yeti with a hundred sixty health.

lines.zh: 她把我背上的沙拍掉了。
lines.en: She brushes the sand off my back.
We look for shade together.
This waste cannot feed many.
It scratches my back for me.

lines.zh: 我们一起躲进唯一的阴凉。
lines.en: We share the only patch of shade.

lines.zh: 风把沙子吹到我们身上。
lines.en: Sand blows over both of us.
The sun is down. Better.
Before dawn, we part.
This stone is within my strength.
I crushed it.
Too small to see.
I kick it aside.
Is it food? I will try.
It is warm.

lines.zh: 我用爪子把它翻过来看。
lines.en: I flip it over with one claw.

lines.zh: 草原的旱雪怪，毛都干硬。
lines.en: A savanna yeti's coat dries stiff.
This is no use.
I dropped it.

lines.zh: 干草被人踩出新的响声。
lines.en: Dry grass crackles under new footsteps.
I lift my head and sniff the sky.
That is not a smell from here.

lines.zh: 我撑地的爪子在土上留下窝。
lines.en: My braced claws leave hollows in the soil.
The ground begins to shake.
I walk that way.
I press my claws into the dry earth.

lines.zh: 我的影子把整片干草盖住。
lines.en: My shadow covers the whole patch of dry grass.

lines.zh: 我蹲低，把重心压到前脚。
lines.en: I crouch and shift my weight to my forelegs.

lines.zh: 你站的地方连草都不长。
lines.en: Nothing even grows where you stand.
I drag my steps and kick up yellow dust.

lines.zh: 我把它赶到没有影子的地方。
lines.en: I herd it out where there is no shade.
My prints mark the sand.
After I roar, my throat is drier.

lines.zh: 我一身旱地的毛，不沾水。
lines.en: My dryland fur sheds water.
There are no trees here.

lines.zh: 太阳底下，它跑不了多远。
lines.en: In this sun it cannot run far.

lines.zh: 我把肩膀侧过来，准备撞。
lines.en: I turn my shoulder to charge.
I raise both arms.
I bring them down.
I sweep it away with the back of my hand.
Sand and soil fly up.
It is pressed into the ground.

lines.zh: 我的拳头砸进土里半尺。
lines.en: My fist sinks half a foot into the dirt.

lines.zh: 干旱草原上，爪子先落下。
lines.en: On the dry savanna, my claws land first.
It struggled once.
My fist sinks into the dirt.
I shake my hand to throw off blood and sand.
I am panting.
It is too hot.
I stand on this waste.
There is no snow here.
The sun is fierce.
I shake the sand from my fur.
The dry wind never stops.
First I look for shade.
The glare bleaches the waste white.
I cannot smell water.
The ground burns underfoot.
I sit down slowly.
This is not like the snowfield.

lines.zh: 我从干裂的地缝里站起。
lines.en: I rise out of a crack in the parched ground.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的毛，焦了一大片。
lines.en: Fire singes a great patch of my fur.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下来，砸出一个坑。
lines.en: Falling from above, I made a crater.

lines.zh: 水一淹上来，我动弹不得。
lines.en: Water rises and I cannot move.
The blast throws me to the ground.
Something is buried in my thick fur.

lines.zh: 这股力量让我的腿发软。
lines.en: This force makes my legs weak.
The waste has little to eat.

lines.zh: 雷打在背上，我整个人一僵。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and I lock up.

lines.zh: 下面空空的，我一直在掉。
lines.en: It is empty below, and I keep falling.
